list.name: Changes
list.comment: Change Summary • Added Graph RAG support to rag-ingest-service ◦ New indexing_mode: STANDARD, GRAPH, BOTH ◦ Shared ingestion flow still handles upload, extraction, chunking, and job tracking ◦ Graph indexing added under app/graph_rag/ ◦ Local Ollama/Mistral generation client added for entity, relationship, and summary extraction ◦ Graph progress/counts added to job status responses • Added Graph RAG database support ◦ New SQLAlchemy models for graph entities, relationships, communities, entity-community links, and summaries ◦ Updated sql/schema.sql ◦ Added separate sql/graph_rag_schema.sql • Added Graph RAG search support to rag-search-service ◦ New endpoint: POST /rag/graph/search ◦ New endpoint: POST /rag/search/combined ◦ Added graph search schemas, repository, and service ◦ Updated search UI to support Standard, Graph, and Combined search • Updated UI ◦ Ingest UI now lets users choose Standard RAG, Graph RAG, or Both ◦ Ingest status UI shows indexing mode, graph entity count, and graph relationship count ◦ Search UI can render graph entities, relationships, summaries, and combined results • Added embedding control for Graph RAG ◦ New flag: GRAPH_RAG_CREATE_CHUNK_EMBEDDINGS=false ◦ GRAPH mode skips chunk embeddings by default ◦ GRAPH mode can create embeddings when the flag is set to true BOTH mode always creates embeddings • Removed Alembic from RAG ingest/search services ◦ Deleted Alembic config and migration folders ◦ Removed Alembic dependencies ◦ Startup now relies on PostgreSQL SQL schema files / optional local create_all • Updated configuration and docs ◦ Updated .env, .env.example, README files, and RAG docs ◦ Moved Graph RAG prompt/implementation plan into modules/rag-ingest-service/docs ◦ Aligned module .env files with their .env.example files • Cleanup ◦ Ignored ingest runtime storage and pytest cache ◦ Removed generated/runtime storage artifacts ◦ Removed old prompt/docs superseded by new Graph RAG docs
